metas.name: VisionQuest
metas.description: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

metas.name: Carrie
metas.description: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

metas.name: Crystal Lake
metas.description: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

metas.name: Avatar: Seven Havens
metas.description: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

metas.name: Friends Sex and Games
metas.description: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

metas.name: Where the Mask Ends
metas.description: An ambitious street urchin seizes the chance to impersonate a noblewoman and becomes a warlord's bride, but when her comatose husband awakens, she must navigate deadly schemes, win his heart through cunning, and uncover her royal heritage to triumph over rivals and rise from gutter to glory.

metas.name: Love in Disguise
metas.description: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?

metas.name: Below
metas.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

metas.name: East of Eden
metas.description: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

metas.name: Doctor X: Mafia in White
metas.description: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

metas.name: Take Charge of My Heart
metas.description: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

metas.name: Coven Academy
metas.description: A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.

metas.name: Merry Berry Love
metas.description: When star Korean spatial designer Lee Yubin loses everything, he heads off to a Japanese island. There, he meets Karin, a resilient strawberry farmer. Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

metas.name: 100 Days of Deception
metas.description: Hoping for freedom, Gyeongseong's top pickpocket infiltrates the Japanese colonial government to steal secrets — only to fall for her target's son.

metas.name: Phony
metas.description: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

metas.name: GET JIRO
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

metas.name: Hollywood Arts
metas.description: Class is in session at Hollywood Arts! Self-proclaimed icon Trina Vega returns to steer gifted teens toward stardom, status and hilarious havoc.

metas.name: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
metas.description: At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands?

metas.name: Kill Jackie
metas.description: Jackie Price has been living a wealthy, luxurious life for the past 20 years after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life begins to feel a little boring, she discovers that The Seven Demons, a group of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her.

metas.name: Irreplaceable
metas.description: After witnessing her mother's suicide following a divorce, Xu Chi defies her tragic fate by rising from an ordinary graduate to a sharp-witted top consultant. Drawn into the covert revenge scheme of seasoned partner Ye Xinzhi, who mentors her while navigating their growing mutual attraction, the duo confronts a crossroads when professional upheavals collide with their evolving bond.

metas.name: LEGO ONE PIECE
metas.description: The Straw Hats hit the high seas in a two-part LEGO special! Join Luffy, Nami, Usopp and the crew on their epic journey, fully reimagined brick by brick.

metas.name: TYSON
metas.description: Explore the explosive life of Mike Tyson — one of the most feared and fascinating figures in sports history.

metas.name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
metas.description: In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.

metas.name: Inside the Circle
metas.description: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

metas.name: A Different World
metas.description: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at her parents' HBCU alma mater and finds their shadow difficult to escape. She sets out to build her own legacy – while having the time of her life – alongside a whole new generation of Hillman’s best and brightest.

metas.name: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
metas.description: Gen Takasegawa, the first Japanese actor to play the lead role at London's Shakespeare’s Globe Theatre, has been unable to return to Japan for some time. After two years, he finally makes his way back home, only to find out that he is suddenly and completely forgotten by the entire world.

metas.name: I Would Rather Die
metas.description: One cold night, misfit Archie gets bitten by a zombie and after briefly considering ending his life, he decides he's going to figure out what the hell is happening to his body. So, with the help of his only friend and his lifelong crush, Archie sets out to find a cure before he turns into a full-blown monster and kills everyone.

metas.name: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
metas.description: The re-opening of a mysterious 1985 cold case murder in Louisiana unearths a haunting history of bloodshed and long-buried trauma.

metas.name: #Love
metas.description: The pragmatic creator of a dating app and her adventurous competitor test their theories about love in a 60-day challenge to find their ideal partner.

metas.name: Habeas Corpus
metas.description: A renowned law professor and a team of students attempt to prove the innocence of a convicted man, but the brightest student is secretly connected to his past.

metas.name: The Flores Massacre
metas.description: The story of Matías Bagnato, the sole survivor of the Flores Massacre, one of the most shocking criminal cases in Argentine history.

metas.name: Shaque: Trust No One
metas.description: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

metas.name: The Arena
metas.description: Ciryl Gane, Cédric Doumbè and Benoît Saint Denis put 38 amateur fighters through brutal trials and cage fights to win €100,000 and a professional MMA contract.

metas.name: Delusion
metas.description: When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.

metas.name: Swipe Right on the Devil
metas.description: Revisits the 2017 murder of 24-year-old Sydney Loofe, who disappeared and was later found dead after going on a Tinder date with Bailey Boswell.

metas.name: The Good Spirit: Behind the Doors of the Opus Dei
metas.description: Fourteen men of all ages from eleven different countries recount their personal experiences within Opus Dei. Many of them held leadership positions while others were called to support the institution from the highest levels of their professional careers to expand Opus Dei. Some were sent as teenagers to countries from which they never returned.

metas.name: Africa Earth's Wild Home
metas.description: African wildlife and landscapes is brought to the screen like never before, using the latest technology to tell the most extraordinary stories from the continent and cutting-edge CGI to unearth the deep history and forces that shaped Africa's natural worlds.

metas.name: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
metas.description: Following a mining accident in northern Chile, 33 miners are trapped deep underground. As the search for them begins, the men are fighting for their lives under extreme conditions.

metas.name: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos
metas.description: A three-part docuseries examining the life and crimes of notorious American serial killer Aileen Wuornos, who shot and killed seven male clients while working as a prostitute in Florida in 1989 and 1990. She was arrested in 1991 and spent around 10 years on death row before being executed in 2002.

metas.name: Sam and Colby: Paranormal Investigators
metas.description: Best friends Sam and Colby visit some of the world’s most haunted locations in search of paranormal evidence, trying to answer one question: Are ghosts real?
